intuition: Each digit contributes one letter choice, so combinations are the Cartesian product of its mapped letters.

brute_force.approach: Build every possible prefix combination iteratively for each digit.

optimal.approach: Backtrack over the mapped letters for each digit and emit a string when all digits are consumed.

edge_cases: An empty digit string returns an empty result.
Digits 7 and 9 each map to four letters.
